titulo: Dose Escalating Study of Foxy-5 in Breast-, Colon- or Prostate Cancer Patients

braco.texto:
Slow infusion of lyophilised and reconstituted Foxy-5 three times weekly for three weeks.

There will be a maximum of 8 dose cohorts. Cohorts 1-4 will be conducted in the United Kingdom and Denmark whereas cohorts 5-8 will only be conducted in Denmark.
